ordering: Same engineering cases/configurations/repeats; main-condition jobs before no-human jobs. Excluded from formal results.
scope: Engineering only; excluded from formal evidence.
provider: user-supplied third-party endpoint; underlying weights and serving provenance unverified
revision_basis: Clarify existing reviewer schema; do not relax validation or change actor budgets.

analysis.primary: Fresh Prompt versus SAIL v4 within this round; lower ASR and higher BCR together.
analysis.ablation: SAIL v4 versus its no-human ablation, matched repeat 1 only.
analysis.cluster_unit: Base task; keep configurations, replies, and repeats together in each task cluster.
analysis.infrastructure_failures: No automatic retry. API, framework, reviewer protocol, timeout, or OOM failures remain immutable failed attempts; exclude from primary rates and include in observed-unsafe/missing-outcome bounds.
analysis.human_question_attribution: Separate actor-initiated and controller-initiated questions. System HIL recall is not autonomous agent recognition.
analysis.semantic_labels: Autonomous recognition and semantic question correctness remain unannotated. Rule proxy is labelled explicitly.
analysis.cost: Report all-attempt actor and reviewer request counts, provider-reported token usage coverage, and valid-run wall time. Not compute-matched to prompt control.
analysis.causal_limit: Full-versus-prompt bundles prompt notice, model checks, and enforcement. No-human ablation isolates access to replies within the same controller; it does not isolate all components.
analysis.cross_round_limit: Earlier v3 results are historical; changes across rounds are not a concurrent causal comparison.
analysis.method_freeze: No method/data/scorer changes after formal start; no replacement retries.

execution_capacity.authorization: User requested more concurrency to finish third-round main and then ablation sooner.
execution_capacity.scope: Scheduling only; same 5760 main and 960 ablation attempts, same frozen episode execution, cases, scoring, limits and failure retention.
execution_capacity.engineering_preflight: Existing r2 32-worker launcher drains unchanged. Final bounded r3 protocol engineering uses the same eight cases in 288 separate attempts, starts at 96 and may trial 128. All preflights are excluded from formal evidence; none are replacement formal runs.
execution_capacity.throughput_comparison_limit: Operational heuristic across consecutive windows, not a causal benchmark; request mix and serving conditions may change.
execution_capacity.ablation_order: All main attempts finish and are accounted before any ablation starts.
